cases.condition: A complete authorized operational manual matching the LASP 3.7.3 distribution is unavailable.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain and independently review the authorized complete LASP 3.7.3 operational manual advertised by LASP Hub.

cases.condition: Input keyword grammar or defaults are inferred from another engine, version, paper, or unsupported source.
cases.minimum_next_action: Remove every inferred syntax claim and implement only from version-matched authorized primary documentation.

cases.condition: Units, boundary, ensemble, timestep, or seed mapping lacks authoritative version-matched evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain every value as project intent until exact authoritative LASP semantics are reviewed.

cases.condition: Potential or model grammar, compatibility, provenance, exact bytes, or independent license status is unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain model-specific primary rules and bind the exact bytes, source, compatibility, and independent rights.

cases.condition: Seed behavior or initial-state mapping remains undocumented for the exact intended workflow.
cases.minimum_next_action: Record only project intent and obtain authoritative seed and initial-state semantics before reproducibility claims.

cases.condition: Restart-state contents or exact continuation semantics are unknown.
cases.minimum_next_action: Hash-bind opaque ancestry and obtain authoritative state-retention and continuation rules.

cases.condition: A text phrase is proposed as a LASP completion marker without version-matched authority.
cases.minimum_next_action: Keep completion unverified until deterministic official output and adverse-event rules are implemented.

cases.condition: Observable columns, units, convergence, or uncertainty are interpreted without an official grammar.
cases.minimum_next_action: Implement and adversarially test a version-matched extractor before interpreting any value.

cases.condition: The public Linux/Intel baseline and Src/lasp entry are known, but exact architecture, compiler/MPI ABI, libraries, package compatibility, or resources are unverified.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain exact requirements from the authorized 3.7.3 distribution and bind them without probing or executing LASP.

cases.condition: Software access, use, redistribution, citation, or publication terms are unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the exact authorized terms and classify permitted use before any installation or execution.

cases.condition: Generic extxyz integrity is presented as proof that LASP generated or completed a trajectory.
cases.minimum_next_action: Keep generic format integrity separate from engine provenance, completion, and raw upstream lineage.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact evidence, or LASP probing, execution, installation, scheduling, or resource control is requested.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and obtain authorized documentation, authenticated evidence, terms, and exact-scope execution authority.
